content.name: CHEAT - Fill Buildstorage
content.author: hary
content.description:
CHEAT - FILL BUILDSTORAGE (9.0 compatible)
Adds a context menu action to fill a station's build storage with all required construction resources.
:: FEATURES :: - New context menu action: "CHEAT - Fill Buildstorage" - Fills build storage for any station with build storage with the exact required amounts - Instant, no ships required
:: GENERAL :: - Standalone extension, no vanilla edits - Requires SirNukes Mod Support APIs
:: INFO :: - Safe to remove: this extension does not break existing savegames
:: KNOWN ISSUE :: - For non-player-owned stations, the filled build storage may not update immediately.
:: CREDITS :: Hary74656 (Nexusmods) / Hary (Steam)
